name: brand-ecosystem-core
description: The strategic, verbal and visual layers of the Brand Ecosystem v1.0 as one module: brand-audit, brand-platform, brand-story, brand-touchpoint and brand-launch, the brand-maker and brand-visual ecosystem companions, plus brand-maker (naming, v2.1 verification-hardened), brand-verify (live verification discipline), brand-visual (visual identity) and figma-forge (design-system to Figma). Adds a verification-guarantee hook layer and isolated critique subagents (diversity-auditor, naive-reader, brand-skeptic, trademark-examiner, etymology-verifier). Composes with the brand-voice plugin for the voice layer.
